Definition: properly, a repetition, i.e. a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication, a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location)
BiblicalUsage: The word is the second, the double, the copy, and it shows up in the king's copy of the law, in the second quarter of Jerusalem where Huldah lived, and in the order of Jesse's sons who followed Saul to the battle.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the copy is the point: the king was to write his own copy of the law and read it all his life, because a ruler who copies God's word will not be ruled by his own.
